methods.label: Track the sector's radius and arc
methods.explanation:
When the straight sides are joined, the sector's center becomes the cone's tip. Each radius of the sector runs along the cone from its tip to its base, so the slant height is \(10\).

The curved edge wraps exactly once around the base. Its length is \(252/360=7/10\) of the circumference of the original circle, so it equals
\[
\frac{252}{360}(2\pi\cdot10)=14\pi.
\]
If \(r\) is the cone's base radius, its circumference is therefore
\[
2\pi r=14\pi,
\qquad r=7.
\]
We need the cone labeled with slant height \(10\) and base radius \(7\). Those are the labels in choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
